Two-pointer with left/right max. O(n) O(1).

For trap two pointer I will move the side with the lower max.

```python
def trap(h):
    lo, hi, lm, rm, out = 0, len(h) - 1, 0, 0, 0
    while lo < hi:
        if h[lo] < h[hi]:
            lm = max(lm, h[lo])
            out += lm - h[lo]; lo += 1
        else:
            rm = max(rm, h[hi])
            out += rm - h[hi]; hi -= 1
    return out
```
